text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen, where dazzling 
stars gather. Nakayama Racecourse was 
wrapped in an atmosphere that could only 
be described as absolute frenzy and 
anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday can surely already see 
the new Marvelous expanding from here 
today. Let's have her deliver stellar 
results in the Arima Kinen to her heart's 
content.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the ones running on the track were 
just as filled with excitement and 
anticipation as the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each person magnified the Marvelous that 
Marvelous Sunday had shared with them, and 
that sparkle shone back upon Marvelous 
Sunday even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just how far will the new Marvelous 
expanding from here today reach— The Arima 
Kinen is finally about to begin!
